info.title: AlterCPA Lite — Tracker, Gangs & Click API
info.description:
Three subsystems: /api/tracker/* (postback, stats, leads, lead, clicks, spend, settings, templates, networks), /api/gangs/* (team-scope wrappers over tracker functions), and the Click/TDS routes (/track-tds/, /track-dom/, /track-pxl/, /track-thx/) which use a different routing mechanism without standard API auth.

tracker/stats, tracker/leads, and tracker/clicks accept GET or POST, support page navigation via show/page, and support column sorting via sort/order (default order is desc).

IMPORTANT: tracker/stats, tracker/leads, tracker/lead, and tracker/clicks return 'payment-required' (not 'unpaid') as the billing error — this answers HTTP 400, not 402.

Success is HTTP 200; an error is answered with the HTTP status of its error code (400 generic, 401 key/auth, 402 unpaid, 403 access/ban, 404 no-id/bad-id/not-found, 500 app/func/db; bot answers 418) and repeated in the X-API-Status and X-API-Error headers.

XApiStatus.description: Result status repeated from the body

XApiError.description: Error code repeated from the body

BadRequest.description: Function-level error (HTTP 400): payment-required (stats, leads, lead, clicks: answered with 400, not 402), no-lead (lead), no-item, no-from, no-to, no-changes, no-params, no-gang (gangs/*); any error code not listed for another status.

Unauthorized.description: Error key (API key missing or wrong) or auth.

Forbidden.description: Error ban (user banned or inactive) or access (lead outside the scope; gangs/*: caller is not the gang admin).

NotFound.description: no-click, bad-click (click code missing or unknown), bad-flow (flow not found); spend: empty (no usable price or filter condition); lead: not-found (no such lead or outside the caller's scope).

ServerError.description: Error db (database failure); framework errors func/app.

PostbackTemplate.description: One CPA-network / affiliate-program preset. Only the fields relevant to the template are present. pb* values are query strings without a leading '?'.

url.description: Offer/landing URL (also used by the TDS fast-redirect lookup)

param.description: Placeholder names ([[name]]) used in the postback query strings

TrafficSource.description: One traffic-source (ad network) preset. Only configured fields are present. Value templates may embed [[placeholder]] macros.

pbnew.description: Outbound postback URL fired on new lead

pbhold.description: Outbound postback URL fired on hold

pbapprove.description: Outbound postback URL fired on approve

pbcancel.description: Outbound postback URL fired on cancel

pbtrash.description: Outbound postback URL fired on trash

param.description: Placeholder names ([[name]]) used in the value templates

goal1.description: Goal breakdown (only when goal is configured)

event1.description: Event breakdown (only when events are configured)

status.description: Character status code: new, hold, approve, cancel or trash (not translated).

os.description: Numeric OS ID detected from the stored user-agent (0=Other, 1=Windows, 2=macOS, 3=Linux, 4=iOS, 5=Android, 6=WindowsMobile, 7=Symbian, 8=BlackBerry); 0 if no UA was stored

browser.description: Numeric browser ID detected from the stored user-agent (0=Other, 1=Chrome, 2=Firefox, 3=IE, 4=Safari, 5=Opera, 6=Edge, 7=Facebook, 8=Instagram, 9=TikTok, 10=WebView, 11=Bot); 0 if no UA was stored

Click.description: One raw traffic-log entry. Unlike Lead, every row here is a click regardless of whether it produced a lead.

sitenext.description: Numeric ID of the second-step site

siteurl.description: Computed site URL, or false when the click has no site

filter.description: Click filter code (0 = passed all filters)

os.description: Numeric OS ID detected from the stored user-agent (0=Other, 1=Windows, 2=macOS, 3=Linux, 4=iOS, 5=Android, 6=WindowsMobile, 7=Symbian, 8=BlackBerry); 0 if no UA was stored

browser.description: Numeric browser ID detected from the stored user-agent (0=Other, 1=Chrome, 2=Firefox, 3=IE, 4=Safari, 5=Opera, 6=Edge, 7=Facebook, 8=Instagram, 9=TikTok, 10=WebView, 11=Bot); 0 if no UA was stored

way.description: Selected way ID. String with comma-separated history when rotor is enabled.

nocookie.description: If true, client must not set cookies

LeadChange.description: One recorded change of the lead's status, price or cost.

to.description: Status number after the change; equals from when only the price or the cost changed

from_status.description: Character status before the change, false if unknown

to_status.description: Character status after the change, false if unknown

LeadDetail.description: One lead with its fields grouped into source, buyer, visitor and tags, plus the status-change history.

gang.description: ID of the team the lead belongs to, 0 if none

date.description: Arrival day as the integer YYYYMMDD

status.description: Character status code: new, hold, approve, cancel or trash (not translated).

custom.description: Raw advertiser status text, false if none

filter.description: Filter result code (same list as in the leads list)

os.description: Numeric OS ID (same enumeration as the os field of the leads list); 0 if no UA was stored

browser.description: Numeric browser ID (same enumeration as the browser field of the leads list); 0 if no UA was stored

tags.description: Each tag is a string or false when empty.

changes.description: Status-change history, oldest first (empty when none)

post.description:
Creates a new lead or updates an existing one matched by click code, subid+flow, or uid+flow. Triggers postback fan-out to per-event URLs configured on the flow.

Parameter merge: primary fields use POST-then-GET priority; tag fields use a GET-wins override — intentional asymmetry.

Error codes by HTTP status: 400 no-changes; 403 access; 404 no-click, bad-click, bad-flow; 500 db.

click.description: Symbolic click code. If negative value, treated as way ID. Required if no flow.

flow.description: Symbolic flow code. Required if no click.

uid.description: Advertiser-side lead ID. Dedup key. Required when using flow+uid combo.

subid.description: SubID dedup key when using flow-only identification.

status.description: Advertiser status string, mapped to the tracker's lead statuses

convert.description: ISO currency to convert price to

addprice.description: Amount to add to existing price

stn.description: CSV of advertiser status strings mapped to new

create.description: Force creation of new lead instead of dedup-update

200.description: Lead created/updated.

create.description: true = new lead created, false = existing updated

post.description: Alternative postback URL. Positive key = user postback (delegates to tracker/postback). Negative key = gang postback (delegates to gangs/postback). The key is from flow.postback.* URL templates.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Encoded flow key. Positive = user scope, negative = gang scope.

200.description: Same response as tracker/postback (positive key) or gangs/postback (negative key); errors use the HTTP statuses of those functions. An empty, unknown or foreign key is rejected before the API runs: HTTP 200 with {status:"error", error:"wrong-code", info:"empty"|"bad-user"|"bad-gang"}.

get.description: Returns aggregated statistics grouped by the chosen item dimension. Parameters may be sent via GET or POST (form-urlencoded or JSON; POST overrides GET). Pass show/page for page navigation — when show is set the stats map is cut to the requested page; the response always echoes page, show, and items (total row count before paging). Sorting (sort/order) is applied to the full result set before paging. Error codes by HTTP status: 400 payment-required, no-item, no-from, no-to.

parameters.name: cur
parameters.description: Currency for money columns (also: curr, currency)

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Gang scope only: filter by team member

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Column to sort by, applied before pagination. Unknown value falls back to name. Absent -> no sorting (natural order).

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction; only asc (case-insensitive) reverses the default desc.

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: Rows per page; presence enables pagination (0/empty -> 100). Absent -> all rows, show=-1 in response.

200.description: Statistics object. Note: payment-required answers HTTP 400 (not 402).

stats.description: Keys are grouping values (e.g. YYYYMMDD for date, country code for geo)

show.description: Echoed page size, or -1 when pagination was not requested

items.description: Total number of grouping rows before paging

get.description:
Returns leads matching filters. Parameters may be sent via GET or POST (form-urlencoded or JSON; POST overrides GET). Pass show/page for page navigation — with show>0 only that page is read and total is the full number of matching leads; without show, all matching leads are returned (show=-1, hard-capped at 10000 rows) so pass show to avoid hitting the cap on large pulls. sort/order are applied by the database.

Both goal= (symbolic code, e.g. 'main') and gl= (numeric goal ID) work. goal= is resolved to the numeric goal ID of the user; if the code is unknown, the filter is silently ignored.

Error codes by HTTP status: 400 payment-required.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Filter by lead date (YYYY-MM-DD, tracker time zone)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Filter by lead date (YYYY-MM-DD, tracker time zone)

parameters.name: os
parameters.description: Numeric OS ID (same enumeration as the os response field)

parameters.name: browser
parameters.description: Numeric browser ID (same enumeration as the browser response field)

parameters.name: hour
parameters.description: Hour of the day of the lead (0-23), counted in the tracker time zone, the same as from/to

parameters.name: goal
parameters.description: Symbolic goal code (e.g. 'main'), resolved to the numeric goal ID. If unknown, filter is silently ignored.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Gang scope only: restrict to team member

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Column to sort by. Accepted keys: id/lead_id (lead ID), time/date (lead time), status, filter, goal, price, cost, geo, flow, way, site. Unknown key -> sorted by lead ID. Absent -> no ordering.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction; only asc (case-insensitive) gives ASC.

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: Rows per page, at most 1000 (a larger value is reduced to 1000 and 1000 is echoed in the response); show>0 enables paging. Absent or below 1 -> all rows (capped at 10000), show=-1 in response.

200.description: Lead array.

show.description: Page size actually used (not more than 1000), or -1 when pagination was not requested

total.description: Total matching leads (full number of matches when paginated, else the number of returned rows)

get.summary: One lead with its status changes
get.description:
Returns one lead by its numeric ID together with the history of its status changes (changes, oldest first). A change is recorded whenever the status, the price or the cost of the lead changes. The owner scope is the same as in the leads list: the user's own leads. Parameters may be sent via GET or POST (form-urlencoded or JSON; POST overrides GET).

The lead fields are grouped into source, buyer, visitor and tags; time, date, gang and changes are extra compared with the leads list.

Error codes by HTTP status: 400 payment-required (subscription expired), 400 no-lead (lead parameter missing), 404 not-found (no such lead or it is outside the caller's scope).

200.description: One lead.

get.description:
Returns click records — the traffic hitting flows — regardless of whether they produced a lead. The click-level analogue of tracker/leads: same filter/pagination/sorting mechanics. Parameters may be sent via GET or POST (form-urlencoded or JSON; POST overrides GET). Pass show/page for page navigation — with show>0 only that page is read and total is the full number of matching clicks; without show, all matching clicks are returned (show=-1, hard-capped at 10000 rows). sort/order are applied by the database.

IMPORTANT: the response array key is 'data', not 'leads' (contrast with tracker/leads).

Error codes by HTTP status: 400 payment-required.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Filter by click date (YYYY-MM-DD, tracker time zone)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Filter by click date (YYYY-MM-DD, tracker time zone)

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: Matched through a 32-bit hash of the IP address

parameters.name: hour
parameters.description: Hour of the day of the click (0-23), counted in the tracker time zone, the same as from/to

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Gang scope only: restrict to team member

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Column to sort by. Accepted keys: id/click_id (click ID), time/date (click time), filter, price, geo, mobile, os, browser, flow, way, site. Unknown key -> sorted by click ID. Absent -> no ordering.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction; only asc (case-insensitive) gives ASC.

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: Rows per page, at most 1000 (a larger value is reduced to 1000 and 1000 is echoed in the response); show>0 enables paging. Absent or below 1 -> all rows (capped at 10000), show=-1 in response.

200.description: Click array (key 'data').

show.description: Page size actually used (not more than 1000), or -1 when pagination was not requested

total.description: Total matching clicks (full number of matches when paginated, else the number of returned rows)

post.description: Bulk-updates the price (cost) of the matching clicks. Supports batch mode via batch[] array in POST/JSON. Error codes by HTTP status: 404 empty.

cpc.description: Price per click (one of cpc/cost/zero required)

from.description: Date range start (YYYY-MM-DD, Unix timestamp, or any date string PHP strtotime understands)

valid.description: Only clicks that passed all filters (click filter code 0)

user.description: Admin: target user ID or 'any' to remove user filter

gang.description: Webmaster gang admin: opt into gang scope

batch.description: Array of spend items for batch import

200.description: Counts of ok/bad items.

post.description: Saves per-user or per-gang tracker configuration. At least one parameter required. No gangs/ alias — team admins use scope=gang (a field of the POST body here, not the query-string scope); any other caller sending scope=gang gets scope and nothing is written. Error codes by HTTP status: 400 scope, no-params.

scope.description: gang = save the team's config block; team admins only, else error scope (nothing is written). Default user.

200.description: ok.

get.description: Read-only dump of the postback-template reference book (presets for CPA networks / affiliate programs shown in the flow editor). No parameters. The body merges the built-in book (refreshed every 10 minutes by the tracker's scheduled job) and the user-generated book (IDs offset by +10000); both share the same field set. Each pb* value is a query string without the leading '?': the final network callback URL is {postback_base}?{pb*} with [[placeholder]] macros (from param) substituted.

200.description: Templates object keyed by numeric template ID.

data.description: Keys are numeric template IDs (user-generated IDs offset by +10000)

get.description: Read-only dump of the traffic-source (ad network) reference book shown in the flow editor. No parameters. The body merges the built-in book (refreshed every 10 minutes by the tracker's scheduled job) and the user-generated book (IDs offset by +10000); both share the same field set. Value templates may embed [[placeholder]] macros substituted when the source is applied to a flow. Note: networks use long postback keys (pbglobal/pbnew/...) whereas templates use short codes (pb/pbn/...).

200.description: Traffic sources object keyed by numeric source ID.

data.description: Keys are numeric source IDs (user-generated IDs offset by +10000)

post.description: Identical to tracker/postback but operates in gang scope. Caller must be the gang admin. Additional errors: no-gang (caller not in team), access (not admin).

200.description: Same response as tracker/postback. Gang-specific errors: no-gang (caller is not in a team, HTTP 400) and access (caller is not the gang admin, HTTP 403).

get.description: Same as tracker/stats but scoped to the gang. Optional user= to drill into a specific team member.

200.description: Same response as tracker/stats. Gang-specific errors: no-gang (caller is not in a team, HTTP 400) and access (caller is not the gang admin, HTTP 403).

get.description: Same as tracker/leads but scoped to the gang. Optional user= to filter by team member.

200.description: Same response as tracker/leads. Gang-specific errors: no-gang (caller is not in a team, HTTP 400) and access (caller is not the gang admin, HTTP 403).

get.description: Same as tracker/lead but the lead is looked up among the team's leads. Optional user= requires the lead to belong to that team member.

200.description: Same response as tracker/lead. Gang-specific errors: no-gang (caller is not in a team, HTTP 400) and access (caller is not the gang admin, HTTP 403).

get.description: Same as tracker/clicks but scoped to the gang (identical structure to gangs/leads). Scoped to the team's clicks; optional user= filters by team member.

200.description: Same response as tracker/clicks (key 'data'). Gang-specific errors: no-gang (caller is not in a team, HTTP 400) and access (caller is not the gang admin, HTTP 403).

post.description: Same as tracker/spend but scoped to the gang. wm/user targets a specific team member; without them, applied across the whole gang.

200.description: Same response as tracker/spend. Gang-specific errors: no-gang (caller is not in a team, HTTP 400) and access (caller is not the gang admin, HTTP 403).

post.summary: TDS — register click by flow code
post.description: Called by server.php installed on the client's domain. Posts visitor's $_SERVER superglobal (form-encoded) + cookie field. No API token auth — the flow code in the path is the identifier.

requestBody.description: All $_SERVER keys + cookie array, form-encoded. Use http_build_query($_SERVER) + '&cookie=' + json_encode($_COOKIE).

QUERY_STRING.description: Contains UTM params, subid, adid, cpc, cur, data1-5, next

200.description: TDS response or error (no-id, bad-id, bad-flow, no-ways, no-data, db).

post.summary: TDS — register click by parked domain
post.description: Same as track-tds but looks up flow by parked domain. If REQUEST_URI contains a filename, serves domain verification files instead.

200.description: Same TDS response or error. Additional errors: no-domain, bad-path.

post.description: Tracking pixel for events. Also accessible as /{uid}/pixel, /{uid}/pixel.gif, /{uid}/pixel.png, /{uid}/pixel.json. Uses cookie x{uid} to find the click.

cookie.description: JSON-encoded $_COOKIE (must contain x{uid} key with encoded click ID)

get.description: QUERY_STRING value with postback fields: uid, status, goal, price, currency, name, phone, email, etc.

200.description: 1×1 GIF image (.gif default), PNG (.png), or JSON (.json). HTTP 418 on lead error, 404 on critical error.

post.description: Same as track-pxl but automatically sets status=approve. Also accessible as /{uid}/thanks, /{uid}/success.

200.description: 1×1 GIF, PNG, or JSON. status=approve is set automatically.
